chapter: Jelly Roll, Boyman Ham and piano players
title: Best piano players of his youth
summary: He names Tony Jackson, Alfred Wilson and Albert Cal, who played with Robichaux, as the finest pianists.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Was he what you'd call a first-class piano player? Did he compare with others, like Tony Jackson? Oh, no.
No. Who was the finest piano player, in your opinion? Some of the finest.
During my time of coming up, when I was, I was playing piano. Yeah, I know.
Well, their fellow was older than me. They're great piano players. That was Tony Jackson, Alfred Wilson, Albert Cal. How would you spell that?
He was from, he was from Miss Lula's home, I think, of White Castle, too. He played piano with John Robichaud.
